actions.reason: C0006 has strong biological support from two distinct sources: RNA shows 9 significant pathways with large effect sizes (e.g., MYOGENESIS SMD=-1.511, IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING SMD=1.100) and WXS shows significant BAP1 enrichment (50% vs 7.7%, q=0.0165). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI and RNA silhouettes and highest patient support (median 3). No significant technical confounding per-set. The identity is defensible as an inflammatory/interferon-driven BAP1-mutant subtype.

C0005 is heavily confounded by technical factors: significant per-set associations with ct_manufacturer (GE OR=0.04, q=4.6e-05; SIEMENS OR=7.87, q=0.006), scanner model, and reconstruction kernel. The strong CT silhouette (0.274) and CT-driven boundary separation are explained by imaging acquisition parameters rather than biology. No significant biological support in RNA, WXS, or CNV. The technical explanation dominates, so Drop is appropriate.

C0004 lacks significant biological support across all modalities: no RNA pathways, no WXS genes, no CNV features at FDR<0.05. Cross-modal consistency is weak with high PAC (0.738) and low resampling ARI (0.532). No significant technical confounding, but the absence of any coherent molecular signature and weak structural cohesion make the set indefensible. No supported split or merge exists, so Drop is chosen.

C0003 has weak biological support: only one RNA pathway significant (PROTEIN_SECRETION q=0.022), no WXS or CNV significant findings. Cross-modal consistency is weak with only CT positive silhouette and some patients with zero support. No significant technical confounding, but the evidence is insufficient to establish a distinct identity. No supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists, so Drop is appropriate.

C0002 has meaningful support from two distinct sources: CNV shows 7 significant continuous features (e.g., chr20q lower, chr16p lower, q=0.014) and RNA shows 5 significant pathways (e.g., PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS SMD=0.819, q=0.035). WXS shows nominal PBRM1 enrichment (63.2% vs 32.1%, p=0.018) but not FDR-significant. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with WSI and RNA positive silhouettes and median support 2. No significant per-set technical confounding. The identity is defensible as a PBRM1-mutant subtype with copy-number losses.

C0001 has strong RNA support with 22 significant pathways and large effect sizes (e.g., PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS SMD=-1.447, HEME_METABOLISM SMD=-1.148). WXS and CNV show only nominal trends, but the RNA signal is robust and coherent. Cross-modal consistency shows RNA positive silhouette and moderate resampling ARI (0.749). No significant per-set technical confounding. The identity is defensible as a metabolic-downregulated subtype, with RNA providing the primary support and no active contradiction from other modalities.
